Amenities means the integral facilities and services provided along with the Unit by the Management Company to enhance the comfort of the Buyer, including but not limited to internet ( WiFi ), laundry, housekeeping, room service, valet parking, and other similar amenities. 
 
 CAM Charges means the amount payable by the Buyer for Amenities and for the purpose of Common Areas Maintenance (“ CAM ”) including but not limited to operational management, administration, maintenance, upkeep, replacement (where required) and security of the Common Areas, Common Facilities and parking area. 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of providing Amenities along with maintaining, operating or managing the Project or any part thereof, including, inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Purchased Unit means the fully constructed and finished service apartment as specifically described in Schedule A and shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Agreement. 
 
 White Goods means the household appliances provided in the Purchased Unit(s), as specified in Table A in Appendix C.
